title.en: One more condition does no harm

after.zh: 在没有框的<wiki-ref to="hilbert"></wiki-ref>里，K 是一条不用证的<wiki-ref to="axiom"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: In a <wiki-ref to="hilbert"></wiki-ref>, which has no box, K is an <wiki-ref to="axiom"></wiki-ref>, taken without proof.

hint.en: What can be seen from inside the box?
How many →s are in the goal?

hint.zh: 里面的框看得见外面框的假设。
hint.en: The inner box sees the outer box’s assumption.

t.zh: 已经成立的事，加上什么条件都还成立：不管刮不刮风，下雨就是下雨。这句话叫 <part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref>。
t.en: What holds still holds under any extra condition: windy or not, it rains. The sentence is called <part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref>.
